headline: JSW Dulux reports 9.2% drop in Q2 net profit to Rs 89 crore
hook: Profit dips despite higher revenue at JSW Dulux
summary: JSW Dulux, formerly Akzo Nobel India Ltd, reported a 9.2% decline in net profit to ₹89 crore for the July-September quarter, compared to ₹97.8 crore in the same period last year. Total revenue for the quarter rose to ₹962 crore according to a regulatory filing. The paints maker faces margin compression as higher sales failed to translate into bottom-line growth. Retail investors holding the stock should review upcoming margin trends in the competitive paints sector.
whats_next: December quarter earnings results in January 2025
why_it_matters: Earnings growth slows for the paints maker.

headline: JSW Dulux appoints Bahram Navroz Vakil as independent director
hook: New independent director joins JSW Dulux board
summary: JSW Dulux Limited has announced the appointment of Mr Bahram Navroz Vakil as an Independent Director of the company. The appointment is effective from November 04, 2026. This is a standard corporate governance update from the listed entity. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note leadership and board composition changes.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact on stock price.

headline: JSW Dulux stock split: Last day to buy for eligibility
hook: Final chance for JSW Dulux split eligibility
summary: JSW Dulux has announced a 1:10 stock split, meaning shareholders will receive ten shares for every one currently held. Investors must purchase the stock by the record date to qualify for the split. This corporate action increases the number of outstanding shares while proportionally reducing the price per share. Retail investors should note that the split does not change the total value of their investment.
whats_next: Record date for the 1:10 stock split
why_it_matters: Increases share count and liquidity without changing total investment value.
